name: artel
description: Artel — Your fleet's smart notepad — one that learns.

plugins.name: artel
plugins.description: Turns Artel into a notepad that speaks up. Surfaces the note you need at the moment you need it — your last handoff at session start, relevant notes and skills on each prompt, file-anchored gotchas right before you edit that file — and writes the session back down afterwards, automatically. Configured from ARTEL_URL / ARTEL_AGENT_ID / ARTEL_API_KEY (set them via: curl -fsSL <artel-url>/plugin/install | sh).
